review.rationale: 任何一项双攻失败补偿、本次破魂印盾仍清强及真实允许回复的溢出已落实；无真正多精灵依赖。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 双方实际用招各令敌双攻-1，任意一项未成功就清自身异常并永久+30%红伤最高150%；敌弱化末封次轮属性，否则魂印回最大HP三分一，允许结算的理论回复净溢出每整10授10源盾及下轮1%减伤，硬封锁不造溢出；受击前魂印源盾存在包含本次打破均受击后清强。

success.name: 4937双方真实用招各令敌双攻降1，无效仍用招、药剂与控制未行动不触发；敌弱化次轮封属
success.assertion: test('4937双方真实用招各令敌双攻降1，无效仍用招、药剂与控制未行动不触发；敌弱化次轮封属',()=>{const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true});turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,-2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spa,-2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock.start,2);timer(s,0,'skillBlock');turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,-4);turn(s,null,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,-4);s.fighters[0].ailments['睡眠']=6;s.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠']=6;turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,-4);});

success.name: 4937双攻任一项失败均解除自身异常并永久增伤每次30%最高150%，不回滚已成功另一项
success.assertion: test('4937双攻任一项失败均解除自身异常并永久增伤每次30%最高150%，不回滚已成功另一项',()=>{const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,1,'免弱');s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞']=4;for(let n=1;n<=3;n++){turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.renado2132.layers,Math.min(5,n*2));}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞'],undefined);const p=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true});p.fighters[1].stages.atk=-6;turn(p,29433,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].stages.atk,-6);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].stages.spa,-2);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.renado2132.layers,2);assert.equal(p.round,2);});

success.name: 4937永久增伤上限150%应用真实攻击，增加不变为翻倍叠乘
success.assertion: test('4937永久增伤上限150%应用真实攻击，增加不变为翻倍叠乘',()=>{const s=make({move:10127,index:-1,soul:true}),b=make({move:10127,index:-1});s.fighters[0].soulState.renado2132.layers=5;timer(s,1,'免弱');timer(b,1,'免弱');turn(s,10127,20309);turn(b,10127,20309);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(b)*2.5)<=2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.renado2132.layers,5);});

success.name: 4937无敌弱化魂印回复max三分一，溢出每整10授10源盾及下轮1%减伤，同源刷新异源保留
success.assertion: test('4937无敌弱化魂印回复max三分一，溢出每整10授10源盾及下轮1%减伤，同源刷新异源保留',()=>{for(const [hp,expected]of[[6009,0],[6010,10],[6011,10],[8500,2500],[9000,3000]]){const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true,hp});timer(s,1,'免弱');S.refresh(s.fighters[0],37,'foreign');turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,Math.min(9000,hp+3000));assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],source),expected);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],'foreign'),37);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.renado2132.reduction,Math.min(1,expected/1000));if(expected){turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],source),3000);}}});

success.name: 4937溢出按一般回复倍率处理，技能禁疗不影响魂印，真正回复归零不凭空产生溢出盾
success.assertion: test('4937溢出按一般回复倍率处理，技能禁疗不影响魂印，真正回复归零不凭空产生溢出盾',()=>{for(const mode of['skillBan','cut','zero']){const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true,hp:8000});timer(s,1,'免弱');if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');else timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:mode==='cut'?.5:1});turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='zero'?8000:9000);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],source),mode==='skillBan'?2000:mode==='cut'?500:0);}});

success.name: 4937受击前魂印源盾存在则受击后清强，包含当次破盾，异源盾不冒充
success.assertion: test('4937受击前魂印源盾存在则受击后清强，包含当次破盾，异源盾不冒充',()=>{for(const kind of['own','foreign','break']){const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,1,'免弱');s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;S.refresh(s.fighters[0],kind==='break'?1:5000,kind==='foreign'?'foreign':source);let beforeEnd;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0)beforeEnd=S.sourceValue(c.a,source);}};try{turn(s,29433,10127);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,kind==='foreign'?2:0);if(kind==='break')assert.equal(beforeEnd,0);}});

success.name: 4937已答双攻仅一项成功仍清自身异常并永久加一层，双方用招分别触发，双成功不补偿且满层不超5
success.assertion: test('4937已答双攻仅一项成功仍清自身异常并永久加一层，双方用招分别触发，双成功不补偿且满层不超5',()=>{for(const capped of ['atk','spa',null,'both']){const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞']=5;if(capped==='both')timer(s,1,'免弱');else if(capped)s.fighters[1].stages[capped]=-6;let first;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)first={layers:c.a.soulState.renado2132.layers,ailment:!!c.a.ailments['凝滞'],atk:c.t.stages.atk,spa:c.t.stages.spa};},()=>turn(s,29433,20309));assert.equal(first.layers,capped?1:0);assert.equal(first.ailment,!capped);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.renado2132.layers,capped?2:0);if(capped&&capped!=='both')assert.equal(first[capped],-6);if(capped){for(let i=0;i<2;i++)turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.renado2132.layers,5);}}});

success.name: 4937已答本次打破魂印源盾仍清敌正强，受击前无源盾或仅异源不清；免红零伤命中仍按受击前盾判
success.assertion: test('4937已答本次打破魂印源盾仍清敌正强，受击前无源盾或仅异源不清；免红零伤命中仍按受击前盾判',()=>{for(const mode of ['break','own','foreign','none','immune']){const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,1,'免弱');s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;s.fighters[1].stages.spe=1;if(mode!=='none')S.refresh(s.fighters[0],mode==='break'?1:5000,mode==='foreign'?'foreign':own);if(mode==='immune')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');let received;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='receivedAttack'&&c.a.side===0)received={shield:S.sourceValue(c.a,own),atk:c.t.stages.atk,spe:c.t.stages.spe};},()=>turn(s,29433,10127));assert.ok(received);const clear=['break','own','immune'].includes(mode);assert.equal(received.atk,clear?0:2);assert.equal(received.spe,clear?0:1);if(mode==='break')assert.equal(received.shield,0);if(mode==='immune')assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);}});

success.name: 4937魂印溢出只从允许的实际理论回复产生：一般倍率和技能禁疗独立，硬封锁及零倍率无假盾，满血仍可真溢出
success.assertion: test('4937魂印溢出只从允许的实际理论回复产生：一般倍率和技能禁疗独立，硬封锁及零倍率无假盾，满血仍可真溢出',()=>{for(const [mode,hp,shield]of [['plain',8000,2000],['skillBan',8000,2000],['half',8000,500],['zero',8000,0],['hard',8000,0],['hardFull',9000,0],['full',9000,3000]]){const s=make({move:29433,index:-1,soul:true,hp});timer(s,1,'免弱');if(mode==='skillBan')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='half'||mode==='zero')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:mode==='half'?.5:1});if(mode.startsWith('hard'))timer(s,0,'四杀鬼囹');turn(s,29433,20309);assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],own),shield,mode);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.renado2132.lastOverflow.overflow,shield,mode);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,['hard','hardFull','zero'].includes(mode)?hp:9000);}});

success.assertion: test('4937全部基础4/5实例分别验证真实等级、概率两支及六级边界，10麻痹含免疫失败',()=>{for(const id of[4,5])for(const item of rows(id)){const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=(item.args[1]<100?24:1);seed++){const s=make({...item,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);const v=s.fighters[id===4?0:1].stages[keys[item.args[0]]];assert.ok(v===0||v===item.args[2]);seen.add(v!==0);}assert.deepEqual(seen,item.args[1]===100?new Set([true]):new Set([true,false]));const s=make(item),side=id===4?0:1,k=keys[item.args[0]],cap=item.args[2]>0?6:-6;s.fighters[side].stages[k]=cap;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],cap);}const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({...row(10),seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([true,false]));});

success.name: 4937全部基础4/5实例分别验证真实等级、概率两支及六级边界，10麻痹含免疫失败
success.assertion: test('4937全部基础4/5实例分别验证真实等级、概率两支及六级边界，10麻痹含免疫失败',()=>{for(const id of[4,5])for(const item of rows(id)){const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=(item.args[1]<100?24:1);seed++){const s=make({...item,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);const v=s.fighters[id===4?0:1].stages[keys[item.args[0]]];assert.ok(v===0||v===item.args[2]);seen.add(v!==0);}assert.deepEqual(seen,item.args[1]===100?new Set([true]):new Set([true,false]));const s=make(item),side=id===4?0:1,k=keys[item.args[0]],cap=item.args[2]>0?6:-6;s.fighters[side].stages[k]=cap;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],cap);}const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({...row(10),seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([true,false]));});

success.name: 4937/2严格低半体威力翻倍，43技能最大HP二分一回复受禁疗，基础先制射线为1
success.assertion: test('4937/2严格低半体威力翻倍，43技能最大HP二分一回复受禁疗，基础先制射线为1',()=>{const values=[];for(const hp of[4499,4500]){const s=make({...row(2),targetHp:hp});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);values.push(sum(s));}assert.ok(values[0]>values[1]*1.8);for(const ban of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(43),hp:1000});if(ban)timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,ban?1000:5500);}const s=make({move:10334});turn(s,10334,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);});

success.name: 4937/191真实反弹异常，1926下一次攻击越过免攻后消费，843下两轮先制2

success.assertion: test('4937全部基础4/5实例分别验证真实等级、概率两支及六级边界，10麻痹含免疫失败',()=>{for(const id of[4,5])for(const item of rows(id)){const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=(item.args[1]<100?24:1);seed++){const s=make({...item,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);const v=s.fighters[id===4?0:1].stages[keys[item.args[0]]];assert.ok(v===0||v===item.args[2]);seen.add(v!==0);}assert.deepEqual(seen,item.args[1]===100?new Set([true]):new Set([true,false]));const s=make(item),side=id===4?0:1,k=keys[item.args[0]],cap=item.args[2]>0?6:-6;s.fighters[side].stages[k]=cap;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],cap);}const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({...row(10),seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([true,false]));});

success.assertion: test('4937/1683只保护消除吸取不挡反转，433每回全属性共三回，1397严格低半翻倍',()=>{const s=make(row(1683));s.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;for(const action of['clear','steal','reverse'])observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(action==='clear')c.clearBoost(c.t);if(action==='steal')c.steal(c.a,c.t,'skill');if(action==='reverse')c.rewriteStageValues(c.t,{atk:-2},'reverse');}},()=>{turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,action==='reverse'?-2:2);});const p=make(row(433));turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);for(let i=0;i<4;i++){for(const k of keys)assert.equal(p.fighters[0].stages[k],Math.min(3,i+1));if(i<3)turn(p,null,20309);}for(const hp of[4499,4500]){const q=make({...row(1397),hp});turn(q,q.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].stages.atk,hp===4499?2:1);}});

success.name: 4937/1065实际用招按低体阈值回复及实际等量粉伤，免粉照回、技能禁疗不回、药剂不触发
success.assertion: test('4937/1065实际用招按低体阈值回复及实际等量粉伤，免粉照回、技能禁疗不回、药剂不触发',()=>{for(const [hp,n]of[[2999,9000],[3000,4500]])for(const mode of['normal','immune','ban']){const s=make({...row(1065),hp});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),['immune','ban'].includes(mode)?0:Math.min(9000-hp,n));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='ban'?hp:Math.min(9000,hp+n));if(s.fighters[1].hp>0){const before=s.fighters[0].hp;turn(s,null,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,Math.min(9000,before+250));}}});

success.assertion: test('4937/2366完整红伤严格高于300才当回合减回复100%，300不触发且效果到期',()=>{for(const cap of[300,301]){const s=make(row(2366));s.moveDefinitions[key(s.auditMoveId)].power=2000;timer(s,0,'攻击输出上限',{amount:cap});let fraction=null;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)fraction=c.a.effects['回复效果削减']?.fraction??null;}};try{turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(sum(s),cap);assert.equal(fraction,cap===301?1:null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,cap===301?8699:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['回复效果削减'],undefined);}});
